Volumetric Fog Using 3D Textures in OpenGL - opengl
1. Allocating the Frustum Volume (Froxels) Rather than using an axis-aligned world-space grid, volumetric fog typically relies on a view-frustum-aligned grid. In OpenGL, this structure is stored as an immutable 3D texture allocated via glTexStorage3D with a target of GL_TEXTURE_3D.
